decisions.reason: As a visibly promoted core-upholstery launch that is still young enough for any weaker uptake to be read as temporary, management is likely to continue backing it despite some rising pressure to prune the range.

Its own page, clear functional flame-retardant specification and strong fit with the firm's contract-curtain business make management especially reluctant to reverse course after already committing development and reputation to it.
Because this 2024 launch was publicly presented on its own page and extends the established upholstery-and-curtain offer, management will probably give it more time rather than admit failure so soon.
